ValidationRule.description: Payment Terms must be 1-12, and cannot be changed once a payment has been marked Paid.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Payment_Terms__c)), OR(Payment_Terms__c < 1, Payment_Terms__c > 12)), AND(ISCHANGED(Payment_Terms__c), NOT(ISNEW()), Total_Paid__c > 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment Terms must be between 1 and 12 and cannot be changed after a payment has been marked Paid.
